dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if I want to go to Narukami Island...

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: You want to go to Narukami Island? You need to apply for a Travel Permit first.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: You've come at a good time.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Nowadays, the authorities are strict. As long as the required materials are ready, it should be much easier to apply than before.
